name: Oono Atsushi
source:
Hatsuyuki's father and Kasuga's former leader. 

[spoiler]His family was killed by a terrorist attack indirectly launched by Sasaki. He tried to take revenge but failed and died in prison, so he possessed his son and appointed Ran to cultivate his son into a tool of revenge.[/spoiler]
